001package org.clafer.frontend;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.IdentityHashMap;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Map;
007import java.util.Optional;
008import org.clafer.frontend.Ir.*;
009
010/**
011 * The core of the explicit IR: a model is core if and only if it has no rich
012 * node ({@link Node#isRich()}).
013 */
014public final class Core {
015
016    private Core() {
017    }
018
019    /**
020     * @param model a model
021     * @return its rich nodes, outermost first, in the order of the source
022     */
023    public static List<Node> richNodes(Model model) {
024        List<Node> rich = new ArrayList<>();
025        walk(model, rich);
026        return rich;
027    }
028
029    /**
030     * @param model a model
031     * @return the diagnostics of a model that declares itself the core
032     * ({@code --core}) but has rich constructs, one at each
033     */
034    public static List<Diagnostic> richInCore(Model model) {
035        List<Diagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
036        if (model.options().core()) {
037            Map<Node, ClaferDecl> owners = new IdentityHashMap<>();
038            ownersOf(model, owners);
039            for (Node node : richNodes(model)) {
040                diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(positionOf(node, owners), "The core has no " + describe(node)
041                        + ": the model declares itself the core (--core)"));
042            }
043        }
044        return diagnostics;
045    }
046
047    /**
048     * The position of a rich construct, as the compiler gives it: a
049     * multiplicity of an abstract clafer at its clafer, a pattern or a
050     * transition at its first operand, as in the provenance comments.
051     */
052    private static SourceSpan positionOf(Node node, Map<Node, ClaferDecl> owners) {
053        return switch (node) {
054            case AbstractMultiplicity a -> owners.get(a).span();
055            case Pattern p -> ToCore.position(p);
056            case Transition t -> ToCore.position(t);
057            default -> node.span();
058        };
059    }
060
061    /**
062     * The clafer of each abstract multiplicity.
063     */
064    private static void ownersOf(Node node, Map<Node, ClaferDecl> owners) {
065        if (node instanceof ClaferDecl d) {
066            d.abstractMultiplicity().ifPresent(a -> owners.put(a, d));
067        }
068        for (Node child : children(node)) {
069            ownersOf(child, owners);
070        }
071    }
072
073    /**
074     * @param node a node
075     * @return what it is, e.g., "enumeration"
076     */
077    public static String describe(Node node) {
078        return switch (node) {
079            case EnumDecl e -> "enumeration";
080            case Modifier m -> "temporal modifier " + m.kind().keyword();
081            case Initializer i -> "initializer " + i.kind().syntax();
082            case AbstractMultiplicity a -> "multiplicity of a top-level abstract clafer";
083            case Anchor a -> "anchor " + (a.initially() ? "initially" : "finally");
084            case Pattern p -> "behavioral pattern " + ToCore.patternOp(p);
085            case Transition t -> "transition";
086            default -> node.getClass().getSimpleName();
087        };
088    }
089
090    private static void walk(Node node, List<Node> rich) {
091        if (node.isRich()) {
092            rich.add(node);
093        }
094        for (Node child : children(node)) {
095            walk(child, rich);
096        }
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * @param node a node
101     * @return its children, in the order of the source
102     */
103    public static List<Node> children(Node node) {
104        List<Node> c = new ArrayList<>();
105        switch (node) {
106            case Model m -> {
107                c.addAll(m.elements());
108                c.addAll(m.objectives());
109                c.addAll(m.assertions());
110            }
111            case ClaferDecl d -> {
112                c.addAll(d.modifiers());
113                c.add(d.groupCard());
114                c.add(d.name());
115                d.superName().ifPresent(c::add);
116                d.ref().ifPresent(c::add);
117                c.add(d.card());
118                d.abstractMultiplicity().ifPresent(c::add);
119                d.initializer().ifPresent(c::add);
120                c.addAll(d.elements());
121            }
122            case RefDecl r -> c.add(r.target());
123            case Initializer i -> c.add(i.value());
124            case AbstractMultiplicity a -> c.add(a.card());
125            case Constraint k -> c.add(k.exp());
126            case EnumDecl e -> {
127                c.add(e.name());
128                c.addAll(e.literals());
129            }
130            case RootBlock r -> c.addAll(r.constraints());
131            case Objective o -> c.add(o.exp());
132            case Assertion a -> c.add(a.exp());
133            case Decl d -> {
134                c.addAll(d.locals());
135                c.add(d.set());
136            }
137            case Join e -> {
138                c.add(e.left());
139                c.add(e.right());
140            }
141            case Dref e -> c.add(e.left());
142            case ParentOf e -> c.add(e.left());
143            case Unary e -> c.add(e.arg());
144            case Binary e -> c.addAll(e.operands());
145            case IfThenElse e -> {
146                c.add(e.condition());
147                c.add(e.then());
148                c.add(e.otherwise());
149            }
150            case Quantified e -> {
151                c.addAll(e.decls());
152                c.add(e.body());
153            }
154            case QuantifiedSet e -> c.add(e.set());
155            case Call e -> c.addAll(e.args());
156            case RelationOf e -> c.add(e.clafer());
157            case Cast e -> {
158                c.add(e.base());
159                c.addAll(e.type());
160            }
161            case Connected e -> {
162                c.add(e.nodes());
163                c.add(e.relation());
164            }
165            case ConstantSet e -> c.addAll(e.type());
166            case Temporal e -> c.addAll(e.args());
167            case Anchor e -> c.add(e.body());
168            case Pattern e -> c.addAll(e.args());
169            case Transition e -> {
170                c.add(e.from());
171                e.guard().ifPresent(c::add);
172                c.add(e.to());
173            }
174            case This e -> {
175            }
176            case NameExp e -> {
177            }
178            case IntLit e -> {
179            }
180            case DecimalLit e -> {
181            }
182            case DoubleLit e -> {
183            }
184            case StringLit e -> {
185            }
186            case NoClafer e -> {
187            }
188            case Name e -> {
189            }
190            case Card e -> {
191            }
192            case Modifier e -> {
193            }
194        }
195        return c;
196    }
197
198    /**
199     * @param node a node
200     * @return the first temporal node of a tree, core or rich, if any: a
201     * temporal operator, modifier, anchor, pattern or transition
202     */
203    public static Optional<Node> firstTemporal(Node node) {
204        if (node instanceof Temporal || node instanceof Modifier || node instanceof Anchor
205                || node instanceof Pattern || node instanceof Transition) {
206            return Optional.of(node);
207        }
208        for (Node child : children(node)) {
209            Optional<Node> t = firstTemporal(child);
210            if (t.isPresent()) {
211                return t;
212            }
213        }
214        return Optional.empty();
215    }
216}
